title: 第8章 超级魔兽库亚塔
slug: 魔兽剑圣异界纵横全本免费-魔兽剑圣异界纵横最新章节列表
content_zh:
死亡森林深处，原本是大多高阶魔兽的地盘，可是由于黑龙的到来，占据了最深处的所在。
庞大的龙威散发出来，一些较弱小的魔兽，受不了龙威的压迫，便逃出了深处，跑向外围。
可是也有一些本来就是森林霸主的存在，实力和生产后的黑龙不分上下，虽然在龙威的范围内，发挥不出全部的实力，可是猛虎架不住狼多啊，一个打不过，找三个总行吧？在经过几次的战斗之后，黑龙也就只好的无奈的妥协，任它们继续在这里生存。
****************
库亚塔今天有些生气，上周才去跟那头蛮横的黑龙打了一架，第一次虽然被打得很惨，但是，它库亚塔是什么兽啊？盘横在死亡森林深处上百年时间的永恒霸主。。之一。。。
在找齐兄弟后，四头九阶顶尖魔兽又向黑龙发起了挑战。
那一战，可真的是天昏地暗啊，一直打了三天方才罢休。
最后，那头黑龙也不得不低下那高傲的头颅，跟它们划分了地盘。
因为打败了黑龙，库亚塔这几天心情一直非常的好。
那可是黑龙呐，若不是这次它生产了，自己可能早被它抓去当早餐了吧。
嘿嘿，不过不管怎么说，总算是打败了它，这以后又有跟别的兄弟吹嘘的资本了，哈哈。
不过，从今天早上起来，库亚塔的好心情又被打破了。
因为那该死的龙威又开始侵占自己的地盘了，这让自己非常的不舒服，浑身上下就象是在被噬骨蚁啃咬一般。
正打算再去找那头丑陋的黑龙算算帐的时候，又不知道什么时候，一大群人类又开始进入了自己的领地，这又让它极其恼怒。
正好，先把这些弱小的人类收拾了，再去找黑龙吧。
***************
众人看着出现在眼前的巨大魔兽，脸色有些苍白。
“九阶顶尖魔兽，魔牛库亚塔。”苏菲身子有些发抖，嘴中喃喃道。
“魔牛库亚塔？它也有名字吗？”刘枫非常疑惑，出言问道。
“人类，不要把伟大的库亚塔和那写低贱的弱小魔兽相比。。。”震天声音从眼前的魔兽口中吐出，在森林之中不断的回荡。

“你会说话？？”刘枫心中着实有些震惊不已，能说话的怪物？那在地球上不就是妖怪了么。
“哼，这有什么了不起的，伟大的库亚塔不仅会说人类的话，还有精灵的，矮人的，兽人的，不要用你那渺小的目光去看待伟大的库亚塔。”巨大的牛鼻上喷出一股白烟,显示出它内心的骄傲。
这话可让刘枫有些羞愧不已了，想不到人家一头魔兽都懂四族语言，比自己好到姥姥家去了。
旁边的苏菲，见到刘枫脸上的愕然，不由捂嘴笑道：“老公，你可不要小看魔牛库亚塔，据说，它可是游历过半个大陆的超级魔兽，智慧不下于人类，而且它还是最有可能问鼎圣阶的魔兽哦。”
“哈哈，小姑娘还不错。”库亚塔那震天的声音又响了起来，还略带着笑音。
“库亚塔大人，我是中夏帝国的代表，还希望你能看着昔日先皇的面子上，放我们过去。”中夏帝国的领队，挺身出队向库亚塔恭敬道。
刘枫心中有些意外，这中夏帝国的领队，进入森林这么久以来，这或许是第一次说话吧。
“中夏帝国的？秦鼎的后人吗？有什么证据？”库亚塔翻了翻那巨大的眼皮。
“库亚塔大人，您请看，这是你当年留给先皇的牛角。”中夏帝国的领队，从手上空间戒指中，取出一截足有几米长的巨大牛角。
看着那巨大的牛角，库亚塔眼神中终于泛起了波动，轻轻的向前走了俩步，地动山摇。
似乎是觉得自己的身躯实在是太过庞大，库亚塔停了下来。
一阵剧烈的强光突现，众人不由自住的捂住双眼。
片刻后，光芒弱了下来，睁开眼来。
看着眼前的壮实大汉，刘枫终于明白了它是如何游历大陆的了。
面前的这位大汉，足有俩米多高，极为强壮，可能是因为本体是魔兽的原因，散发出一股远古凶兽的嗜血气息，浑身上下疤痕累累，可以想象这位战斗狂人经历过多么惊险的战斗。
俩步走上前来，从中夏领队手中捞过牛角，细细***，虎目中隐有泪光闪现。

content_en:
The depths of the Death Forest were originally the territory of most high-level monsters, but due to the arrival of the black dragon, they occupied the deepest part.
The huge dragon's power radiated out, and some weaker monsters, unable to withstand the oppression of the dragon's power, escaped from the depths and ran to the outside.
But there are also some beings who are the overlords of the forest. Their strength is equal to that of the black dragons after production. Although they cannot exert their full strength within the scope of Longwei, tigers cannot stand up to many wolves. If they can't be defeated by one, why don't they find three head offices? After several battles, the black dragons had no choice but to compromise and let them continue to survive here.
****************
Kuyata was a little angry today. He had a fight with that arrogant black dragon just last week. Although he was beaten badly the first time, what kind of beast was Kuyata? The eternal overlord who has been in the depths of the Death Forest for hundreds of years. . one. . .
After finding all the brothers, the four top ninth-level monsters challenged the black dragon.
That battle was really dark, and it lasted for three days before it stopped.
In the end, the black dragon had to lower its proud head and divide its territory with them.
Because he defeated the black dragon, Kuyata has been in a very good mood these days.
That was the black dragon. If it hadn't given birth this time, I might have been captured by it for breakfast.
Hehe, but no matter what, I finally defeated it, and now I will have bragging rights with other brothers, haha.
However, starting this morning, Kujata's good mood was broken again.
Because that damn Long Wei began to encroach on his territory again, which made him very uncomfortable, as if his whole body was being bitten by bone-eating ants.
Just when he was about to go find the ugly black dragon to settle the score, at some point, a large group of humans began to enter his territory again, which made him extremely angry.
Just in time, take care of these weak humans first, and then go find the black dragon.
***************
Everyone looked a little pale as they looked at the huge monster that appeared in front of them.
"The ninth-level top magical beast, Demonic Cow Kuyata." Sophie murmured as her body trembled a little.
"The Demonic Cow Kuyata? Does it also have a name?" Liu Feng was very confused and asked.
"Humans, don't compare the great Kuyata with that weak and humble monster..." A shocking voice spat out from the mouth of the monster in front of him, echoing continuously in the forest.
"You can talk??" Liu Feng was really shocked. A monster that can talk? Wouldn't that be a monster on earth?
"Humph, what's so great about this? The great Kuyatta can not only speak human words, but also elves, dwarves, and orcs. Don't look at the great Kuyatta with your petty eyes." A stream of white smoke erupted from the huge cow's nose, showing its inner pride.
These words made Liu Feng feel a little ashamed. He didn't expect that a magical beast could understand the languages ​​of the four tribes, and he was better than himself at his grandma's house.
Sophie, who was standing next to her, saw the astonishment on Liu Feng's face and couldn't help covering her mouth with a smile: "Honey, don't underestimate the Demonic Bull Kuyata. It is said that it is a super magical beast that has traveled half of the continent. Its intelligence is no less than that of humans, and it is also the most likely to aspire to the Holy Order."
"Haha, the little girl is not bad." Kuyata's loud voice sounded again, with a hint of laughter.
"Lord Kuyata, I am the representative of the Zhongxia Empire. I hope you can look out of the former emperor's face and let us pass." The leader of the Zhongxia Empire stepped forward and respectfully greeted Kuyata.
Liu Feng was a little surprised. This might be the first time that the leader of the Zhongxia Empire spoke after entering the forest for so long.
"From the Zhongxia Empire? Descendants of Qin Ding? What evidence is there?" Kuyata rolled his huge eyesSkin.
"Lord Kuyata, please see, this is the horn you left for the late emperor." The leader of the Zhongxia Empire took out a huge horn several meters long from the space ring in his hand.
Looking at the huge horns, Kuyata's eyes finally flickered, and he took two steps forward gently, causing the ground to shake.
As if feeling that his body was too big, Kuyata stopped.
A burst of intense bright light suddenly appeared, and everyone couldn't help but cover their eyes.
After a while, the light weakened and he opened his eyes.
Looking at the strong man in front of him, Liu Feng finally understood how he traveled across the mainland.
The big man in front of him was over two meters tall and extremely strong. Perhaps because he was a Warcraft, he exuded the bloodthirsty aura of an ancient ferocious beast. His body was covered in scars. You can imagine what thrilling battles this battle madman had gone through.
He walked forward in two steps, took the horns from the hands of the team leader Zhongxia, and kissed them carefully, with tears flashing in the tiger's eyes.
